tagline: Advancing observability for today's digital businesses through AI-powered insights
hero_kpi_rationale: ARR is a key indicator of financial health and the company's ability to generate predictable recurring revenue, reflecting the value of active SaaS subscription contracts

kpis.name: Annualized Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue generated by active subscriptions
kpis.description: ARR is a key indicator of the company's financial health. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical values over the past 5 years.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company, including subscriptions and professional services
kpis.description: Total revenue is a key indicator of the company's financial health

kpis.name: GAAP Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Company operating revenue in accordance with GAAP standards
kpis.description: GAAP operating income is a key indicator of the company's profitability

kpis.name: Non-GAAP Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Adjusted company operating revenue, excluding stock-option charges and amortization
kpis.description: Non-GAAP operating income is a key indicator of the company's adjusted profitability

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated by the company after capital expenditures
kpis.description: Free Cash Flow is a key indicator of the company's cash generation

kpis.name: DPS Revenue Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of ARR revenue generated by customers using the flexible DPS licensing model
kpis.description: Percentage of DPS customers is a key indicator of adoption of the flexible licensing model

kpis.name: Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Ratio of ARR from customers active 1 year ago compared to their current ARR, measuring expansions and contractions
kpis.description: Net retention rate reflects the company's ability to retain and expand its existing customer base
kpis.signal: Positive net expansion of existing customers

kpis.name: Non-GAAP Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP operating income as a percentage of total revenue
kpis.description: Non-GAAP operating margin reflects the company's operational efficiency

risks.title: Potential growth slowdown
risks.score_rationale: Although the company has experienced rapid growth (19% in 2025, 23% in 2024, 25% in 2023), this growth may not be sustainable. The ability to maintain future growth depends on critical factors such as attracting new customers, retaining existing customers, and expanding use cases.

risks.title: Increased competition in the observability market
risks.score_rationale: The observability solutions market is highly competitive and constantly evolving. The company must continuously innovate to preserve its technological position and avoid losing market share to established competitors or new entrants.

risks.title: Dependence on economic and macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Demand for observability solutions depends on enterprise IT infrastructure spending, which fluctuates with general economic conditions, interest rates, currencies, and investor confidence.

risks.title: Integration risks following acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: If the company pursues an acquisition strategy to accelerate innovation or acquire new technological capabilities, integrating these acquisitions presents operational and valuation risks.

risks.title: Complexity of multi-cloud interoperability
risks.score_rationale: The Dynatrace platform must operate effectively in complex hybrid and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-premises, mainframe). Any interoperability dysfunction could hinder adoption or cause deployment delays.

ai_positioning.summary: DT does not have significant mentions concerning artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F report.
